asked.item: Am I paying after clicking the UPGRADE popup when trial credits ran out
How to check my subscription status

verdict.reason: The help pages say clicking the UPGRADE popup after running out of free trial credits converts the trial to a paid subscription, and they say where to check billing.

steps.text: Clicking the UPGRADE popup after running out of free trial credits converts your free trial to a paid subscription.
To check your subscription, go to Settings > Billing and click View Billing Portal.
